readings.Aries: Your capacity to begin is extraordinary. The question today is about depth, not speed. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Taurus: Your sense of value — what things are worth, what people cost — is usually accurate. Check it again today. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Gemini: Something that feels like boredom is actually your mind signalling that you're underusing it. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Cancer: The past you return to had things in it that were real and good and also things that were not. Hold both. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Leo: Your creativity needs an outlet or it will find one you didn't choose. Give it space. Let this one be easy.
readings.Virgo: You've been adjusting yourself to fit a space that doesn't fit you. That adjustment has a cost. Let this one be easy.
readings.Libra: Your need for balance is not weakness — it's an accurate reading of what makes systems work. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Scorpio: The investigation you're conducting on someone else — conduct it on yourself for a day. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Sagittarius: You are better at starting than finishing. This particular thing deserves to be finished. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Capricorn: The thing you are in service of — your family, your work, your future self — check that it still deserves the service. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Aquarius: You are loyal to your ideas in the way others are loyal to people. Someone needs you to be loyal to them instead. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Pisces: Your inner life is extraordinarily rich. The outer life sometimes doesn't know what to do with it. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
